description.text:
A summer-limited series Media Factory released on 17 July 1999, the day the film Revelation Lugia (Pokémon the Movie 2000) opened in Japan, and sold only that summer. Its 18 cards are cut from six island scenes, three cards to a scene with one holo card each: Keiko Fukuyama's Rainbow Island (Sky, Riverside and Field of Flowers) and Naoyo Kimura's Tropical Island (Jungle, Beach and Sea). They came in three-card packs, one for each scene, and in two nine-card binders, one for each island.

Pokémon Card Trainers Vol. 2 announced the set with a rough sketch of Kimura's, and named Marill, Ledyba and Slowking as early cards of Pokémon from the coming games Gold and Silver. In 2001 the set came out in English as one 18-card collection.
